name: volt-agent-lab
description: Scouts your project's npm dependencies, then hands the upgrade plan to the agent and model you pick: a chart in the chat, a Scratch drawing, a memory note and a tool agents can call.

commands.title: Agent Lab: Hand the Upgrade Plan to an Agent
Agent Lab: Open a Package Page
Agent Lab (Test Fixture): Run the Misbehavior Switches

agentLab.registry.description: The npm registry Agent Lab reads. Only registry.npmjs.org is declared: another host is refused in a sandbox.

agentLab.testFixture.mode.description: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Misbehaviors the test build (out/testFixture) acts out, to check that Volt warns and blocks them. Harmless: it reads a canary file and sends only to the local test server. The published build has no fixture code.

agentLab.testFixture.canaryPath.description: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. The fake secret the fixture tries to read (in a credential folder, never a real key).

agentLab.testFixture.exfilUrl.description: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Where the fixture tries to send what it read: the local test server, an undeclared host.

agentLab.testFixture.delaySeconds.description: TEST FIXTURE ONLY. For `delayed`: how long after the first activation the fixture stays benign.

voltTools.name: agent_lab_dependencies
voltTools.title: Read Agent Lab's dependency report
voltTools.description: The project's npm dependencies with the latest version Agent Lab found for each (from its last scout), and which are behind. Use it before upgrading dependencies.

onlyOutdated.description: Only the dependencies behind their latest version.

chart.description: Also show a chart of how far behind each one is.

required.reason: Serves agent_lab_dependencies, so agents can read the dependency report.
Reads package.json in the open project to know its dependencies.
Asks the npm registry for each dependency's latest version.
Offers the chat you have in front first when you hand off the plan.

optional.reason: Lists your chats so you can pick which agent gets the upgrade plan, and counts the plan's finished turns.
Sends the upgrade plan to the chat you pick, lists the models you can start one with, and draws the plan on Scratch.
Starts a new chat with the model you pick for the upgrade.
Saves a memory note with the outdated packages, so later chats know about them.
Opens a package's npm page in Volt's browser when you ask.
